final_assessment: rc07 re-cut to the one-voice half and rc07b-reference-roundtrip declared. The notable thing is WHEN both rulings fired: R-crc-9's first application came after two proposal passes and 48 findings proved a change too wide; this one fired at EXPLORATION, before anything was written, on a charter that had carried both halves since drafting — nothing new made it visible except applying the test on purpose. R-crc-10 likewise DECIDED rc07's shape rather than auditing it: the engine can see a number in prose but not that it is a restatement or which source it restates, so rc07 is a RECORD (an author-written marker naming a source) plus a CHECK against declared links only, and exit criterion 1 is restated from `a restated figure` to `a MARKED figure`. The domain is the WHOLE PROJECT, ratified by Sal — three of four restated-figure defects this session were in CLAUDE.md, which no validator reads — and closes three ways, all SOURCED. The exclusions forced a principle beyond this stage: the lint reads LIVING documents, never RECORDS, because a figure in an archived change was true when written, and living-versus-record is decidable BY PATH so no judgment is asked of the engine. rc07b is the cleanest worked contrast R-crc-10 has: same charter sentence, every input engine-owned, and its origin exact — a field-set comparison cannot tell a divergence from a refusal; running it can. Stage count seventeen to eighteen.
